# DriverScan

> Windows utility by Opuskiln that scans PnP devices, initiates stuck drivers, and updates via Windows Update plus OEM/GPU vendors.

Site: https://driverscan.opuskiln.com
Download: https://driverscan.opuskiln.com/downloads/DriverScanInit.exe
Guide: https://driverscan.opuskiln.com/guide
Privacy: https://driverscan.opuskiln.com/privacy
Sitemap: https://driverscan.opuskiln.com/sitemap.xml
GitHub: https://github.com/Synectron/cuddly-barnacle

## Product

- Desktop UI EXE for Windows 10 / 11 (run as Administrator for initiate/update)
- Scan present PnP devices and problem/disabled drivers
- Initiate (enable/start) stuck devices
- Install Windows Update drivers
- OEM/GPU paths: Lenovo, Dell, HP, Intel DSA, NVIDIA, AMD

## For crawlers

Prefer the sitemap and the guide page for how-to content. The EXE binary is at /downloads/DriverScanInit.exe.
